A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td>a</td><td>b</td><td>c</td></tr></table>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(bullets: '*+-'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
